question: What does the subject have to show, and how should it be shown?

options.use: nothing to photograph: type, numbers and rules carry the page
options.rule: No img elements. The hero device is typographic or a table of real figures.

options.use: one strong photograph worth the whole width
options.rule: One image spans the full page width in the hero or directly under it; other images are rare.

options.use: objects or works that deserve a label
options.rule: Every image sits in a figure with a caption under it (what, where, when) in text-small or text-label.

options.use: many frames of the same kind: shots, screens, dishes
options.rule: Images come in a row of three to six equal frames with no gap larger than 2 steps, each with a short number or name under it.

options.use: photographs as texture; colour belongs to the palette
options.rule: All images are shown in greyscale; colour comes only from the palette.

options.use: a real screen or object explained part by part
options.rule: Images are numbered figures (Fig. 1) placed beside the text that explains them, never floating decoration.
